title: Compose — Defined Terms — Output Schema (compose-defined-terms)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-defined-terms' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 044, FR-11). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema in infra/dataverse/actions/compose-defined-terms.action.json. Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required arrays, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator. The 'consistent' boolean is a value-typed field (legal); the ban is on the property-level required keyword only.

terms.description: One entry per defined term found in the document.

definitionSpan.description: Verbatim text snippet where the term is defined.

usages.description: Each place the term is used, with a consistency judgment.

span.description: Verbatim text snippet of the usage.

consistent.description: True if this usage is consistent with the term's definition.

note.description: Short explanation of any inconsistency; empty string when consistent.

inconsistencies.description: Defined-term problems (inconsistent usage / used-but-undefined / defined-but-unused). Empty when all defined terms are consistent.
